problems: 2012-13 remains significant: no roster exists anywhere. The adjudicator uses start_year from the transfer-in rows as the entry year, so Jamil shows as 2013, Yoon as 2015, Agnoletto as 2019 and Bin-Alamer/Skandalakis as 2026. The roster's PGY arithmetic gives 2012, 2012, 2017, 2024 and 2025. For consolidation: add BWH (program 37) transfer-in for Maren Loe (PGY-1, mid 2025-26), and UVM (program 112) should note Dylan Adams' 2023-24 Utah year. Alumni page: no 2014 column; Mumert/Sayama (2007 class) finished after PGY-6 (terminal_pgy_by_entry_year).
